ns2:course.label: Intensive Elementary Spanish
ns2:course.description: Intensive beginning Spanish, equivalent to the first two semesters, for students with little or no experience in Spanish or whose skills need refreshing. This is considered a second level course for the purposes of fulfilling the Language Other Than English (LOTE) requirement. Instruction in Spanish. Credit is not given towards graduation for both SPAN 122 and SPAN 102; students who have the equivalent of four or more years credit in Spanish at the secondary level will not receive credit towards graduation for SPAN 122. Prerequisite: None or assignment by placement exam.
